notes: Your saved layouts and settings are now protected while the app runs - nothing can wipe them mid-save anymore. Split clips get a new choice: keep your face the same in every video and change only the screen side. One-take pitches are found on their own now, no setting to click. Scheduling and submitting use far fewer Buffer calls, so shared keys stop hitting the limit.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.52.
